channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: antigravity.google: Google Antigravity Agentic Platform
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides a unified SDK and runtime for deploying and managing stateful, production-grade AI agents directly on cloud-native platforms like GKE.

item.title: Crossplane
item.description: [CRITICAL] Transforms Kubernetes into a universal control plane capable of orchestrating both application containers and external cloud infrastructure declaratively.

item.title: NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin: NVIDIA device plugin for Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides the essential hardware-scheduling interface required to orchestrate GPU acceleration for enterprise AI and machine learning workloads.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Istio is the definitive enterprise service mesh standard driving production-grade mTLS security, observability, and the shift toward ambient mesh architectures.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 provides the foundational CNCF GitOps Toolkit controllers that power automated, modular reconciliation loops in modern cloud-native clusters.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] It represents the foundational CNCF time-series and alerting standard that powers monitoring across Kubernetes environments.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the CNCF-graduated, industry-standard core container runtime powering modern Kubernetes clusters globally.

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kueue: Kubernetes-native Job Queueing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the modern Kubernetes-native batch scheduling engine critical for managing distributed AI/ML job queues and multi-tenant resource quotas.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] Vault remains the foundational enterprise standard for secrets management, dynamic credentials, and zero-trust data protection across multi-cloud architectures.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the ubiquitous, vendor-agnostic telemetry collection and routing backbone across modern cloud-native architectures.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] Velero is the ubiquitous, production-proven standard for Kubernetes disaster recovery, data protection, and PV backup migration.

item.title: trivy
item.description: [CRITICAL] Trivy serves as the industry-standard multi-target vulnerability and misconfiguration scanner embedded across modern container build pipelines.

item.title: Announcing Claude Managed Agents on Cloudflare
item.description: [CRITICAL] Establishes a serverless, sandboxed execution plane at the network edge for autonomous agents using Cloudflare Workers infrastructure.

item.title: New in Terraform 1.15: Dynamic sources, variable deprecation, and more
item.description: [CRITICAL] Introduces dynamic module sources and variable deprecation, fundamentally modernizing modular dependency architecture in core Terraform.

item.title: Argo CD
item.description: [CRITICAL] Argo CD remains the premier industry standard for declarative, GitOps-based continuous delivery across enterprise Kubernetes environments.

item.title: gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Gateway API defines the future standard for Kubernetes ingress, advanced layer 7 routing, and unified cross-mesh traffic specifications.

item.title: Apache Kafka
item.description: [CRITICAL] Apache Kafka remains the de facto industry standard for distributed event streaming and real-time messaging architectures.

item.title: OPA Open Policy Agent 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Open Policy Agent is the CNCF graduated benchmark for unifying policy-as-code enforcement across Kubernetes, microservices, and CI/CD pipelines.

item.title: github.com/containernetworking 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] The CNI specification and core plugin ecosystem form the foundational networking fabric connecting containers across all cloud-native runtimes.

item.title: Kubecost 🌟
item.description: [HIGH] Delivers the industry benchmark for Kubernetes cost observability, granular resource allocation, and cloud FinOps optimization.
